name: Bajaj Finserv Ltd.
business_summary: Financial-services holding company of the Bajaj group. Holds about 51% of Bajaj Finance (NBFC, the dominant earnings and value driver), plus general insurer Bajaj General Insurance (BAGIC) and life insurer Bajaj Life (BALIC) (Allianz exited the JVs - model knowledge, verify), Bajaj Finserv Lending, AMC and health/securities units. Q2 FY27 consolidated PAT Rs2,758cr per headlines (+23%), NII +24%, AUM +26%; screener consolidated net profit incl. minorities Rs5,952cr. Subscribing Rs5,800cr warrants in Bajaj Finance. Stock -11.9% over 3 months; Goldman initiated a sell call; analysts flagged insurance concerns. New BAGIC CEO Deepak Reddy from Jan 2027 and plan to enter reinsurance.

exposures.mechanism: ~75% of look-through value is Bajaj Finance (-3.0 per +25bp repo, see BAJFINANCE). Insurance float gains (~15% of value) from higher reinvestment yields (+0.3) partly offset => ~-2.

evidence.note: RBI hiked repo to 5.50%, stance calibrated tightening (The Hindu / SCC Online)

exposures.mechanism: BFL -2.5 x 75% weight = -1.9; insurance investment books gain on reinvestment yields but suffer MTM on bond books; net -2.
BFL -5.0 x ~0.8 weight (holding-company discount means leverage to BFL) = -4; insurance largely unaffected.
BFL: +50bp credit cost = -5.0 x 0.8 look-through weight = -4; insurance credit exposure small.

evidence.note: Q2 PAT Rs2,758cr +23%, NII +24%, AUM +26% (Moneycontrol/ET); shares rebounded 2-4% 2026-11-04, Goldman sell call, Jefferies trims target

exposures.mechanism: BFL -3.5 x 0.8 = -2.8; Bajaj Finserv Lending also unsecured SME loans.
BFL +2.0 x 0.8 + insurance premium growth with credit-linked cross-sell (credit life) => ~+1.8.

Tightening steps (commission/expense-of-management caps, surrender-value norms, GST input-credit loss after individual life/health GST exemption in Sep 2025 - model knowledge) hit margins of general insurer (BAGIC) and life insurer (BALIC): insurance ~20% of value x EBITDA -15% ... ~-3 incl. sentiment. Analysts flagged 'insurance concerns' on 2026-11-04.
BFL +2.5 x 0.8 weight; insurance protection and health demand as urban incomes rise.
Beta 1.06-1.14; VIX +5 hits both BFL multiple and insurer valuations; -2.
FII holding only 8.2% (promoters 58.7%, public 22%): flow sensitivity lower than peers; +1.2.
Agrees with empirical -0.79 (t=-2.1): oil -> inflation/rates and motor-claims inflation at BAGIC.
Empirical +1.66 (t=2.9) is the largest significant coefficient; probably common rate/liquidity beta (gold up when real rates fall) rather than gold-loan exposure; shrunk to +0.8.
Empirical +1.03 (t=2.0): cyclical risk-on beta (copper up = growth up); no direct path; shrunk to +0.3.

company_links.mechanism: w = % change in BAJAJFINSV equity per +1% in BAJFINANCE equity (source-equity-move units). ~51% of Rs6.63 lakh cr mcap = Rs3.4 lakh cr vs BAJAJFINSV mcap Rs2.95 lakh cr (insurance extra) => look-through weight >1; holdco discount and insurance noise bring effective beta to ~0.75 (confirm with regression).
